facts.fact: The ministry's national director says many targets of the Plano de Desenvolvimento Nacional 2018-2022, whose priority actions included broadband access, were missed because of Covid-19, so they were revised and will be executed in the period 2023-2027; the document states no broadband targets of its own.

note: The Projecto Nacional de Banda Larga is described as a fibre backbone project, not a plan with targets, so it gives no fact; no money or results are tied to a plan.
